summary: The comment highlights the importance of E-Rate for schools and the potential negative impact of removing it on their ability to fund basic connectivity needs, which are critical during times of increased educational and technological challenges.

claims.argument: Removing E-Rate will devastate schools' ability to fund basic connectivity needs
claims.evidence_quote: Removing E-Rate will be a way to decimate the edtech landscape and cause schools to be unable to fund basic connectivity needs.
